payload.goal: What a failed external tool printed is kept as evidence wherever TOOL_FAILED says it is. Today ssh-keygen runs with its standard error discarded (ssh_keygen in crates/core/src/record/sign.rs, used by signing, verification and the machine key in crates/core/src/machine.rs), so a failed signature keeps nothing, while the catalogue's TOOL_FAILED says that what the tool printed is kept as evidence; only Git's failures keep theirs (D-083, git::failed).

requirements.criterion: A test makes ssh-keygen -Y sign fail in a person's move (a key file ssh-keygen cannot read as a key) and finds the directory the words name, with ssh-keygen's standard error and its status, at those permissions. The test fails on the current code.
requirements.text: In a write command, a failed ssh-keygen keeps its standard error and exit status in local/evidence/ssh-keygen-<time>-<process>-<n>/ (directory 0700, files 0600), as Git's failures do, and the refusal's words name that directory.

requirements.criterion: A test makes ssh-keygen -Y check-novalidate fail under fabrewk status and fabrewk check: the domain is byte for byte as before, and the words do not claim kept evidence.
requirements.text: A reading command writes nothing, so it keeps no evidence; the words of a TOOL_FAILED it gives say that nothing was kept, never that it was.

requirements.criterion: The catalogue's reason for TOOL_FAILED no longer says unconditionally that the output is kept; the tests that compare help with the catalogue pass.
requirements.text: The catalogue's TOOL_FAILED reason, in en and es-MX, says what is true in every case: the output is kept and named when a command keeps it, and nothing is said kept when none is.

requirements.criterion: The kept files hold only the tool's standard error and its status; the credential scan over local/evidence/ after the tests reports nothing.
requirements.text: Evidence never holds a secret: no passphrase, no private key bytes, no environment.

requirements.criterion: After the failing move of the first criterion, status shows local/evidence/ with more than 0 bytes.
requirements.text: fabrewk status counts the new evidence in local/evidence/'s size.
